description: MainActivity.kt is an Android activity class responsible for managing the calculator app's UI, including input handling, history panel, and interaction with voice search features.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the calculator application's main user interface, including input, result display, history drawer, and voice search integration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds event listeners.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the result box UI element with the provided expression.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression using CalculatorEngine and updates the result display, also storing history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Sets up button click listeners for calculator keypad buttons to append symbols or trigger evaluation.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Configures the history drawer toggle button and overlay click behavior.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Inflates and displays the history drawer with calculation history.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Animates and hides the history drawer overlay.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Fills the history drawer with stored calculation history and wires up clear/close buttons.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the history list if the history drawer is currently visible.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity result events, primarily for speech recognition.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request responses, mainly for speech features.
